text:
Avery (People Ops): Quick heads up — candidate Alex Chen onsite next Wed. We're running staggered panels across HQ + the Satellite office (SF-West). Need room ops, recording consent, and debrief lead confirmed.

Priya (Hiring Manager): Love it. Can we do 9:00–11:30 window with two 45m panels + 15m buffer between? I can lead debrief if others ok. :+1:

Jake (Eng): Works for me. One ask — can we avoid putting the technical live coding in the smaller room? Need projector/monitor.

Lina (Recruiter): I'll collect recording/notes consent from the candidate during check-in. Also verifying timezone on the invite.

Tom (Facilities): SF-W-3 and SF-W-4 are available. SF-W-3 has HDMI + external mic; SF-W-4 is smaller (no projector). If you need a backup, Room: SF-LobbyConf can be reserved. Front desk needs guest name by EOD before visit.

Avery (People Ops): Proposed schedule posted below — please confirm asap so I can lock rooms and send invites.
```
9:00 — candidate check-in (Lobby)
9:15 — Panel A (SF-W-3, 45m)
10:00 — buffer / travel / sync (15m)
10:15 — Panel B (SF-W-4 + Zoom, 45m)
11:00 — 30m debrief (SF-W-3)
```

Priya (Hiring Manager): Confirming debrief lead = Priya. Can we set debrief notes owner to the interviewer who ran Panel A? That person should capture strengths/concerns on the rubric.

Jake (Eng): I'll take notes for Panel A. Quick rubric question — which rubric version do we use? I saw v2 and v2.1 floating around.

Avery (People Ops): Use rubric v2.1 (link: https://notion.redwood/rubric/v2.1). Key change: add explicit anchor for "system design tradeoffs" and call out acceptance criteria for "ship-readiness". Please score 1–5 per section.

Lina (Recruiter): Candidate consent: I'll ask Alex on the phone today to confirm they're ok with a short recording for internal debrief only. If they say no, we'll still do notes but disable recording and send debrief summary via PM.

Tom (Facilities): Access notes: SF-West building requires self-checkin at kiosk; badge printers at lobby. If guest arrives >1 person, front desk requires host on-site. If anyone needs temporary badge provisioning, ping me with names.

Jake (Eng): One more ops detail — can we add a 5m 'shadow buffer' between panels to let panelists swap rooms? Last time that saved us.

Avery (People Ops): Added 5m shadow buffer into the calendar invites. Also tagging calendar-bot to create provisional invites and add video link for Panel B.

calendar-bot: provisional invites created for Alex Chen, Priya, Jake, [Panel B members]. Video link: https://meet.redwood/abc123 (will be attached to final invite).

Priya (Hiring Manager): Perfect. Reminders: 1) Use rubric v2.1, 2) Panel A note-taker = Jake, 3) Debrief in SF-W-3, 4) Recruiter to confirm recording consent.

Lina (Recruiter): On it — I'll DM Alex check-in script and get consent. Will post final confirmation in this thread by EOD tomorrow. :seedling:

Avery (People Ops): Thanks everyone — if no objections by EOD I'll lock rooms and send final invites. If you want to swap panel times, reply here now.

Jake (Eng): All good from me.

Tom (Facilities): Ready on my end for badge provisioning.

Priya (Hiring Manager): Good to go.

Avery (People Ops): Final note — please bring laptops with chargers, have headset for Panel B Zoom, and leave debrief notes in the Notion debrief page linked in the invite.
